reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (agent), on the 2025-06-14 0.16 m RGBI orthophoto and the club's own pages and photos
note: The practice ground is the club's 'komplett övningsområde': a driving range west of Kimstavägen hit from a mat strip with nets by the car park, a putting green beside the range and a chipping green east of the road (the club: 'närspelsområde ... rakt fram vid första tee', 'puttingreen ... bredvid rangen'). The four shorter-cut target circles on the range are not drawn. No retaining walls, revetments or bridges on any hole on the 2025 photo; no cart paths in OSM. Every pond is in Lantmäteriet's break geometry, so no pond is added from the photo.

facilities.why: the mown field between the ditch, the wood and the scrub, hit westwards from the mat strip
the gravel strip with mats and net posts along the range's east edge by the car park
the putting green beside the range, west of Kimstavägen (an OSM green no hole plays to)
the chipping green east of the road, north of the first tee (an OSM green no hole plays to)
